text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a compact runbook pane in the console for automatic fallback events. Operators should immediately see WHY a fallback happened (trigger), WHAT degrade mode was selected, and ONE suggested next action.
kevin: Agree. Minimal view: cause summary + decision trace link + button to open sample request in sandbox. Keep it one click for triage. :mag:
sam: +1 on sandbox replay. Also we need to show policy_version and sampling_id so audits tie back to the rule set.
gloria: Audit log requirement: records must be append-only with policy_version, operator_id (if any), and decision_hash. No backdated edits.
aria: UX thought: show a 1-line human message like "Timed out (1.9s) -> quiet-degrade" and an expandable details drawer for full trace.
kevin: Edge case: when multiple triggers fire (e.g. latency + 5xx spike). UI should surface the precedence and highlight the selected primary trigger. Example: primary=LATENCY, secondary=ERROR_RATE.
maya: good. also include greyed-out suggested rollback if policy threshold hit twice in 5m.
sam: We should show the exact trigger threshold that was crossed, e.g., "p95 latency > 1200ms (current 1900ms)". That helps product folks understand impact.
aria: For operator actions propose: [Acknowledge + Quiet Mode Override], [Replay in sandbox], [Pin fallback reason to incident]. Buttons only if user has permission.
gloria: Make sure the audit event includes a compact decision blob we can export (forensics): e.g.
```
decision: fallback
primary_cause: LATENCY
cause_value: 1900ms (p95)
mode: quiet-degrade
policy_version: v3.4.1
sampling_id: 8a3c2f
```
kevin: Implementation note: the runbook pane can call /internal/fallback/decision/{decision_hash} to fetch full trace — include a short TTL token to avoid leaking.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: autofallback-ui/staging deployed at 1769054350 :rocket:
maya: Nice. Next steps: sam to prototype the one-line + drawer; kevin to wire the decision API + token; gloria to spec audit blob format. Can we aim for a staging demo next Wed?
sam: I can mock it in React — will include sample traces and the replay hook.
kevin: I'll add the /internal endpoint and a feature flag.
gloria: I'll draft the audit schema and add retention rules for export.
maya: Thanks team. Quick follow-up: add an "explain" tooltip that maps internal trigger codes to plain English for non-ops reviewers. (e.g., KV_CACHE_MISS -> "context cache miss, may increase latency").
aria: Also add a tiny timeline bar showing last 10m of p95 and error rate above the one-line summary. Visuals speed triage.
kevin: noted. I'll stub metrics tile in staging UI.
ops-bot: incident-bot: @oncall notified when fallback triggers > 10% of requests for 2m.
maya: Perfect. Logging: keep per-decision small (under 2kb) but link to full logs if needed.
sam: I'll push a demo screenshot when ready.
gloria: Will attach audit schema PR after draft.
maya: End — thanks.
